in_sanskrit.name: अवनीष
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Avneesh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Avani' which means 'radiant' and 'Ish' which means 'god'. Thus, Avneesh can be interpreted as 'radiant god' or 'auspicious and prosperous'. This name is often given to boys in India as it is believed to bring good fortune and success.
